name: How long does mold remediation under carpet take?

mainEntity.name: How long does mold remediation under carpet take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of mold remediation under carpet depends on the severity and scope of the mold growth. Minor cases might be resolved in a few days, while extensive mold issues requiring structural drying and replacement of materials can take a week or more. This timeline includes containment, removal, cleaning, treatment, and thorough drying to prevent recurrence. A professional can provide a more precise timeline after assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold remediation duration varies by severity, from a few days for minor cases to over a week for extensive issues, including drying time.
